samples.summary: New task todo file has every acceptance-criteria checkbox already marked done at creation, with no paired lessons file, and this PR's diff contains no corresponding code changes — the described implementation (sessionNeverRan, poolExhaustedError, POOL_EXHAUSTED, allSamplesFailedError, lensInfraReason) already exists in scripts/agent/{ask,redact,review-panel,prior-findings}.mjs prior to/outside this diff. This is unusual for an 'active/todo' entry (normally unchecked until landed) but I verified the described behavior does exist in the repo, so there is no contradiction — just an odd convention for this task doc.
samples.evidence: All five bullet points under 'Acceptance criteria' are pre-checked with [x] in a file under docs/tasks/active/ (the 'todo' bucket), while the diff for this PR touches only docs/tasks/README.md and this new file — no scripts/agent/*.mjs changes are included here.
